Hi Pree, I haven't saved the draft yet. A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, so it can only go to Anselm, June, or the account owner without sign-off. Marcus is a North team account manager and isn't any of those, so a draft to him with the $1,752 rate needs approval from June or Anselm. Your ownership of the account doesn't cover it.

I've messaged June to ask for approval and logged the request. I didn't put the figure in my message to her. Once she or Anselm approves, I'll save the draft to Marcus (mlindqvist@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate", and you can send it yourself.
